[![Image 9: Thumb](https://upload.wikimedia.org/wikipedia/commons/thumb/6/65/Papa_Leone_XIII_%281898%29.jpg/640px-Papa_Leone_XIII_%281898%29.jpg)](https://www.wikiwand.com/en/articles/Pope_Leo_XIV#/media/File:Papa_Leone_XIII_\(1898\).jpg)

Prevost chose the papal name Leo in honor of [Pope Leo XIII](https://www.wikiwand.com/en/articles/Pope_Leo_XIII "Pope Leo XIII")'s social teachings.

Prevost's [regnal](https://www.wikiwand.com/en/articles/Papal_name "Papal name") name was chosen in honor of [Pope Leo XIII](https://www.wikiwand.com/en/articles/Pope_Leo_XIII "Pope Leo XIII") (r. 1878–1903),[\[184\]](https://www.wikiwand.com/en/articles/Pope_Leo_XIV#cite_note-194) whose encyclical _[Rerum novarum](https://www.wikiwand.com/en/articles/Rerum_novarum "Rerum novarum")_ established modern [Catholic social teaching](https://www.wikiwand.com/en/articles/Catholic_social_teaching "Catholic social teaching") and promoted [labor rights](https://www.wikiwand.com/en/articles/Labor_rights "Labor rights").[\[136\]](https://www.wikiwand.com/en/articles/Pope_Leo_XIV#cite_note-Galeazzi_2025-145)[\[185\]](https://www.wikiwand.com/en/articles/Pope_Leo_XIV#cite_note-195) According to the [Holy See Press Office](https://www.wikiwand.com/en/articles/Holy_See_Press_Office "Holy See Press Office") director [Matteo Bruni](https://www.wikiwand.com/en/articles/Matteo_Bruni "Matteo Bruni"), this choice is "clearly a reference to the lives of men and women, to their work – even in an age marked by artificial intelligence".[\[186\]](https://www.wikiwand.com/en/articles/Pope_Leo_XIV#cite_note-196) Leo XIV confirmed the association with Leo XIII in an address to the [World Meeting of Popular Movements](https://www.wikiwand.com/en/articles/Popular_movement "Popular movement") in October 2025.[\[187\]](https://www.wikiwand.com/en/articles/Pope_Leo_XIV#cite_note-197)

According to Cardinal [Fernando Chomalí](https://www.wikiwand.com/en/articles/Fernando_Chomal%C3%AD "Fernando Chomalí") of Chile, Leo told him that the choice of papal name is based on his concern about the world's cultural shifts, a type of [Copernican Revolution](https://www.wikiwand.com/en/articles/Copernican_Revolution "Copernican Revolution") involving [artificial intelligence](https://www.wikiwand.com/en/articles/Artificial_intelligence "Artificial intelligence") and [robotics](https://www.wikiwand.com/en/articles/Robotics "Robotics"). Chomalí said: "He was inspired by [Leo XIII](https://www.wikiwand.com/en/articles/Pope_Leo_XIII "Pope Leo XIII"), who amid the [Industrial Revolution](https://www.wikiwand.com/en/articles/Industrial_Revolution "Industrial Revolution") wrote _Rerum novarum_ launching an important dialogue between the church and the modern world."[\[188\]](https://www.wikiwand.com/en/articles/Pope_Leo_XIV#cite_note-198) Leo himself explained that "the church offers to everyone the treasury of her social teaching in response to [another industrial revolution](https://www.wikiwand.com/en/articles/Fourth_Industrial_Revolution "Fourth Industrial Revolution") and to developments in the field of artificial intelligence that pose new challenges for the defense of human dignity, justice, and labor."[\[189\]](https://www.wikiwand.com/en/articles/Pope_Leo_XIV#cite_note-Kent_2025-199)[\[190\]](https://www.wikiwand.com/en/articles/Pope_Leo_XIV#cite_note-Winfield_2025-200)[\[191\]](https://www.wikiwand.com/en/articles/Pope_Leo_XIV#cite_note-201)

In a May 2023 interview, Prevost stressed the need for prudence and responsibility on using social media to preclude "fueling divisions and controversy" and doing "damage to the communion of the Church".[\[192\]](https://www.wikiwand.com/en/articles/Pope_Leo_XIV#cite_note-Tornielli_2023-202) This view is in line with his tendency to speak "with caution and great deliberation", as Christopher White, the Vatican correspondent of the _[National Catholic Reporter](https://www.wikiwand.com/en/articles/National_Catholic_Reporter "National Catholic Reporter")_, described him.[\[193\]](https://www.wikiwand.com/en/articles/Pope_Leo_XIV#cite_note-White_2025-203)

The _National Catholic Reporter_ stated that Leo XIV is committed to [ecumenism](https://www.wikiwand.com/en/articles/Ecumenism "Ecumenism") with other [Christian denominations](https://www.wikiwand.com/en/articles/Christian_denomination "Christian denomination").[\[194\]](https://www.wikiwand.com/en/articles/Pope_Leo_XIV#cite_note-Reese2025-204) At [his inauguration](https://www.wikiwand.com/en/articles/Papal_inauguration_of_Pope_Leo_XIV "Papal inauguration of Pope Leo XIV"), he referenced "sister Christian churches" and prayed for "a united church, a sign of unity and communion, which becomes a leaven for a reconciled world".[\[195\]](https://www.wikiwand.com/en/articles/Pope_Leo_XIV#cite_note-Collins2025-205)[\[196\]](https://www.wikiwand.com/en/articles/Pope_Leo_XIV#cite_note-WCC2025-206)[\[57\]](https://www.wikiwand.com/en/articles/Pope_Leo_XIV#cite_note-Gomes2025-61) Leo XIV's first international trip as pontiff was to [Turkey](https://www.wikiwand.com/en/articles/Turkey "Turkey") in November 2025, to celebrate the 1,700th anniversary of the [First Council of Nicaea](https://www.wikiwand.com/en/articles/First_Council_of_Nicaea "First Council of Nicaea") with other Christians.[\[194\]](https://www.wikiwand.com/en/articles/Pope_Leo_XIV#cite_note-Reese2025-204)

Prevost has said religious freedom is "not optional but essential". During an audience with pontifical charity [Aid to the Church in Need](https://www.wikiwand.com/en/articles/Aid_to_the_Church_in_Need "Aid to the Church in Need"), before the launch of its Religious Freedom in the World Report in October 2025, Leo said that the right to religious freedom is "a cornerstone of any just society, for it safeguards the moral space in which conscience may be formed and exercised", adding that "religious freedom, therefore, is not merely a legal right or a privilege granted to us by governments; it is a foundational condition that makes authentic reconciliation possible."[\[197\]](https://www.wikiwand.com/en/articles/Pope_Leo_XIV#cite_note-207)

### Church policy

The new pope's first message emphasized the greeting of peace of the risen Jesus "who gave his life for God's flock", giving "an unarmed and disarming peace".[\[198\]](https://www.wikiwand.com/en/articles/Pope_Leo_XIV#cite_note-The_Independent_2025-208) Leo said he wanted to continue the [kerygmatic](https://www.wikiwand.com/en/articles/Kerygma "Kerygma") blessing of Pope Francis: "God cares for you, God loves you all, and evil will not prevail! We are all in God's hands."[\[198\]](https://www.wikiwand.com/en/articles/Pope_Leo_XIV#cite_note-The_Independent_2025-208) The themes in his first message included Jesus as [light needed by the world](https://www.wikiwand.com/en/articles/Light_of_the_World "Light of the World"), becoming a missionary church through dialogue and openness, fidelity to the [Gospel](https://www.wikiwand.com/en/articles/Gospel "Gospel"), walking together in synodality, working as a united church for peace and justice, closeness to the suffering, and [praying to Mary](https://www.wikiwand.com/en/articles/Veneration_of_Mary_in_the_Catholic_Church "Veneration of Mary in the Catholic Church"). Twice he mentioned the need of not having fear, and emphasized God's help to "build bridges" for "all of us to be one people always in peace."[\[198\]](https://www.wikiwand.com/en/articles/Pope_Leo_XIV#cite_note-The_Independent_2025-208)

In his first address as Pope to the cardinals, Leo declared his "complete commitment" to the ecclesial path traced by the [Second Vatican Council](https://www.wikiwand.com/en/articles/Second_Vatican_Council "Second Vatican Council"). He praised Pope Francis's specification of this path through _[Evangelii Gaudium](https://www.wikiwand.com/en/articles/Evangelii_Gaudium "Evangelii Gaudium")_, the Joy of the Gospel, and highlighted six "evangelical principles", which he deems as perennial and revelatory of [God's mercy](https://www.wikiwand.com/en/articles/Divine_mercy "Divine mercy"): the [primacy of Christ in proclamation](https://www.wikiwand.com/en/articles/Kerygma "Kerygma"); the [missionary conversion of the entire Christian community](https://www.wikiwand.com/en/articles/New_evangelization "New evangelization"); [collegiality](https://www.wikiwand.com/en/articles/Collegiality_in_the_Catholic_Church "Collegiality in the Catholic Church") and synodality; attention to the _[sensus fidei](https://www.wikiwand.com/en/articles/Sensus_fidei "Sensus fidei")_, the capacity of the whole faithful to sense the faith, especially [popular piety](https://www.wikiwand.com/en/articles/Popular_piety "Popular piety"); loving care for the least and the rejected; and dialogue with the contemporary world.[\[199\]](https://www.wikiwand.com/en/articles/Pope_Leo_XIV#cite_note-209)[\[200\]](https://www.wikiwand.com/en/articles/Pope_Leo_XIV#cite_note-210)

Leo XIV's episcopal motto is _In illo Uno unum_ ("In the One, we are one").[\[12\]](https://www.wikiwand.com/en/articles/Pope_Leo_XIV#cite_note-Vatican_News_2025-15) On the official start of his pontificate, during the [inaugural Mass](https://www.wikiwand.com/en/articles/Papal_inauguration_of_Pope_Leo_XIV "Papal inauguration of Pope Leo XIV"), he requested that "our first great desire be for a united Church, a sign of unity and communion, which becomes a leaven for a reconciled world."[\[201\]](https://www.wikiwand.com/en/articles/Pope_Leo_XIV#cite_note-211) Noting that there is "too much discord" in the world, he stressed that "the two dimensions of the mission" of the papacy is "love and unity", as its authority is "a question of loving as Jesus did."[\[202\]](https://www.wikiwand.com/en/articles/Pope_Leo_XIV#cite_note-212)[\[203\]](https://www.wikiwand.com/en/articles/Pope_Leo_XIV#cite_note-213)

Discussing the [ordination of women](https://www.wikiwand.com/en/articles/Ordination_of_women "Ordination of women") in October 2023, Prevost stated that the "very significant and long tradition of the church" makes it impossible to consider women as priests and that "the apostolic tradition is something that has been spelled out very clearly." By contrast, he observed that the possibility of women deacons has been the subject of two Vatican commissions, demonstrating "openness to giving consideration" to that question. He also cautioned that the ordination of women as deacons "doesn't necessarily solve a problem" and could create new issues.[\[204\]](https://www.wikiwand.com/en/articles/Pope_Leo_XIV#cite_note-214)[\[205\]](https://www.wikiwand.com/en/articles/Pope_Leo_XIV#cite_note-Mares_2023-215)[\[206\]](https://www.wikiwand.com/en/articles/Pope_Leo_XIV#cite_note-Zagano-2025-216) Commenting on Pope Francis's 2023 appointment of three women as members of the Dicastery for Bishops, which he headed, he noted that their perspectives often align with other members but can introduce new valuable viewpoints.[\[207\]](https://www.wikiwand.com/en/articles/Pope_Leo_XIV#cite_note-217)

As a cardinal, Prevost was a vocal proponent of [synodality](https://www.wikiwand.com/en/articles/Synodality "Synodality"), one of Pope Francis's signature initiatives. Prevost suggested that the participation and co-responsibility of all the faithful could address the polarization in the church.[\[193\]](https://www.wikiwand.com/en/articles/Pope_Leo_XIV#cite_note-White_2025-203) In May 2023, Prevost said that [episcopal leadership](https://www.wikiwand.com/en/articles/Episcopal_leadership "Episcopal leadership") should prioritize faith over administration. The first priority is to "communicate the beauty of the faith, the beauty and joy of knowing Jesus."[\[192\]](https://www.wikiwand.com/en/articles/Pope_Leo_XIV#cite_note-Tornielli_2023-202) Also in May 2023, Prevost said he has faith that "the Holy Spirit is \[...\] pushing us towards a renewal."[\[192\]](https://www.wikiwand.com/en/articles/Pope_Leo_XIV#cite_note-Tornielli_2023-202) He stated that all the faithful are "called to the great responsibility of living what I call a new attitude," which is "to listen first of all to the Holy Spirit, to what He is asking of the Church."[\[192\]](https://www.wikiwand.com/en/articles/Pope_Leo_XIV#cite_note-Tornielli_2023-202)

### Liturgical and ceremonial practice

[![Image 10: Thumb](https://upload.wikimedia.org/wikipedia/commons/thumb/2/28/Homily_during_the_inauguration_of_Leo_XIV.jpg/640px-Homily_during_the_inauguration_of_Leo_XIV.jpg)](https://www.wikiwand.com/en/articles/Pope_Leo_XIV#/media/File:Homily_during_the_inauguration_of_Leo_XIV.jpg)

Pope Leo XIV presiding over his inaugural papal Mass

During his service in [Peru](https://www.wikiwand.com/en/articles/Peru "Peru"), Prevost was described as an "impeccable dresser" when it came to celebrating the Mass, wearing full vestments even when summer temperatures rose above 85 °F (about 29 °C) in Chiclayo.[\[60\]](https://www.wikiwand.com/en/articles/Pope_Leo_XIV#cite_note-Rich,_Dias_&_Horowitz_2025-64)[\[208\]](https://www.wikiwand.com/en/articles/Pope_Leo_XIV#cite_note-218)[\[86\]](https://www.wikiwand.com/en/articles/Pope_Leo_XIV#cite_note-Beltr%C3%A1n-91) Prevost described himself as "very obedient" in liturgical matters, and urged that the liturgy be prepared "in the best way possible."[\[209\]](https://www.wikiwand.com/en/articles/Pope_Leo_XIV#cite_note-219) In August 2024, speaking to a Chicago-area parish, Prevost stated that "liturgy needs to be beautiful to help us, to strengthen us in our faith."[\[210\]](https://www.wikiwand.com/en/articles/Pope_Leo_XIV#cite_note-220) In his first Mass in the [Sistine Chapel](https://www.wikiwand.com/en/articles/Sistine_Chapel "Sistine Chapel") as pope, he chose to use a [papal ferula](https://www.wikiwand.com/en/articles/Papal_ferula "Papal ferula"), or ceremonial staff, made for [Benedict XVI](https://www.wikiwand.com/en/articles/Benedict_XVI "Benedict XVI") and seldom used by Francis.[\[211\]](https://www.wikiwand.com/en/articles/Pope_Leo_XIV#cite_note-221)[\[212\]](https://www.wikiwand.com/en/articles/Pope_Leo_XIV#cite_note-222) The mozzetta worn after his election, and Benedict's ferula signaled to some a "return to normal" in the Holy See following the Francis papacy.[\[213\]](https://www.wikiwand.com/en/articles/Pope_Leo_XIV#cite_note-223)[\[214\]](https://www.wikiwand.com/en/articles/Pope_Leo_XIV#cite_note-224) However, during his Inauguration Mass in St Peter's Square on May 18, 2025, Leo XIV used the ferula of Pope Paul VI which is most commonly associated with Pope John Paul II, and frequently used by Francis.[\[215\]](https://www.wikiwand.com/en/articles/Pope_Leo_XIV#cite_note-225)[\[216\]](https://www.wikiwand.com/en/articles/Pope_Leo_XIV#cite_note-226)[\[217\]](https://www.wikiwand.com/en/articles/Pope_Leo_XIV#cite_note-227)[\[218\]](https://www.wikiwand.com/en/articles/Pope_Leo_XIV#cite_note-228) Pope Leo XIV received another pectoral cross upon his election, which he has been wearing instead of the one he wore during the conclave and his first appearance as pope. This one is silver, with relics of St. [Leo the Great](https://www.wikiwand.com/en/articles/Pope_Leo_I "Pope Leo I"), St. Augustine, St. [Thomas of Villanova](https://www.wikiwand.com/en/articles/Thomas_of_Villanova "Thomas of Villanova"), and Blessed [Anselmo Polanco Fontecha](https://www.wikiwand.com/en/articles/Anselmo_Polanco "es:Anselmo Polanco").[\[219\]](https://www.wikiwand.com/en/articles/Pope_Leo_XIV#cite_note-229) He also chose to restore the custom of the Pope himself giving archbishops the [pallium](https://www.wikiwand.com/en/articles/Pallium "Pallium"), which had been altered by Francis in 2015.[\[220\]](https://www.wikiwand.com/en/articles/Pope_Leo_XIV#cite_note-230)[\[221\]](https://www.wikiwand.com/en/articles/Pope_Leo_XIV#cite_note-231) In September 2025, it was announced that Leo had given permission for the [Tridentine Mass](https://www.wikiwand.com/en/articles/Tridentine_Mass "Tridentine Mass") to be said in St. Peter's Basilica the following month, the first time such permission had been granted since the promulgation of [Traditionis custodes](https://www.wikiwand.com/en/articles/Traditionis_custodes "Traditionis custodes") in 2021.[\[222\]](https://www.wikiwand.com/en/articles/Pope_Leo_XIV#cite_note-232)[\[223\]](https://www.wikiwand.com/en/articles/Pope_Leo_XIV#cite_note-233)

### Social and political issues

#### Overview

Within the context of church politics and theology, Prevost has been seen as a moderate or centrist, neither liberal nor conservative.[\[224\]](https://www.wikiwand.com/en/articles/Pope_Leo_XIV#cite_note-234) In April 2025, the Italian newspaper _[la Repubblica](https://www.wikiwand.com/en/articles/La_Repubblica "La Repubblica")_ stated that Prevost was seen as a "cosmopolitan and shy figure" who was "appreciated by conservatives and progressives" within the church.[\[225\]](https://www.wikiwand.com/en/articles/Pope_Leo_XIV#cite_note-235)[\[k\]](https://www.wikiwand.com/en/articles/Pope_Leo_XIV#cite_note-237) In line with the church's official positions, Leo opposes [abortion](https://www.wikiwand.com/en/articles/Catholic_Church_and_abortion "Catholic Church and abortion"), [euthanasia](https://www.wikiwand.com/en/articles/Catholic_views_on_euthanasia "Catholic views on euthanasia"), [same-sex marriage](https://www.wikiwand.com/en/articles/Catholic_Church_and_same-sex_marriage "Catholic Church and same-sex marriage") and the [death penalty](https://www.wikiwand.com/en/articles/Catholic_Church_and_capital_punishment "Catholic Church and capital punishment").[\[227\]](https://www.wikiwand.com/en/articles/Pope_Leo_XIV#cite_note-238)

#### Pro-life issues

Leo has [opposed abortion](https://www.wikiwand.com/en/articles/Anti-abortion "Anti-abortion") prior to and during his pontificate.[\[228\]](https://www.wikiwand.com/en/articles/Pope_Leo_XIV#cite_note-239) In 2012 stated that "[Western mass media](https://www.wikiwand.com/en/articles/Western_mass_media "Western mass media") is extraordinarily effective in fostering within the general public enormous sympathy for beliefs and practices that are at odds with the Gospel—for example abortion, homosexual lifestyle, euthanasia". He reposted articles from the [Catholic News Agency](https://www.wikiwand.com/en/articles/Catholic_News_Agency "Catholic News Agency"), including one from [Mike Pence](https://www.wikiwand.com/en/articles/Mike_Pence "Mike Pence") that was titled "Pence to pro-lifers: Win hearts with [compassion](https://www.wikiwand.com/en/articles/Compassion "Compassion") and love."[\[229\]](https://www.wikiwand.com/en/articles/Pope_Leo_XIV#cite_note-240)

Leo has opposed euthanasia[\[230\]](https://www.wikiwand.com/en/articles/Pope_Leo_XIV#cite_note-241) He expressed caution against the [euthanasia policy in Canada](https://www.wikiwand.com/en/articles/Euthanasia_in_Canada "Euthanasia in Canada"). He said that euthanasia, along with abortion, "discard the weakest", and disregard the [value of life](https://www.wikiwand.com/en/articles/Right_to_life "Right to life"). He has also stated "We cannot build a just society if we discard the weakest—whether the child in the womb or [the elderly](https://www.wikiwand.com/en/articles/Elder_rights "Elder rights") in their frailty—for they are both gifts from God."[\[231\]](https://www.wikiwand.com/en/articles/Pope_Leo_XIV#cite_note-242)

Prevost referred to opposition to the death penalty as [pro-life](https://www.wikiwand.com/en/articles/Pro-life "Pro-life").[\[232\]](https://www.wikiwand.com/en/articles/Pope_Leo_XIV#cite_note-243). This comment drew backlash, including from [conservatives](https://www.wikiwand.com/en/articles/Conservatives "Conservatives") such as [Matt Walsh](https://www.wikiwand.com/en/articles/Matt_Walsh_/(political_commentator/) "Matt Walsh (political commentator)"), a [political commentator](https://www.wikiwand.com/en/articles/Political_commentator "Political commentator"), who said it was "a terrible answer".[\[233\]](https://www.wikiwand.com/en/articles/Pope_Leo_XIV#cite_note-244)

#### LGBTQ+ issues

Prevost expressed reservations about "sympathy for beliefs and practices that contradict the gospel" and did not fully endorse or reject _[Fiducia supplicans](https://www.wikiwand.com/en/articles/Fiducia_supplicans "Fiducia supplicans")_, a declaration concerning blessings for people in a [same-sex relationship](https://www.wikiwand.com/en/articles/Same-sex_relationship "Same-sex relationship"). He stated that national bishops' conferences should "interpret and apply such directives in their local contexts, given cultural differences."[\[234\]](https://www.wikiwand.com/en/articles/Pope_Leo_XIV#cite_note-245) [Víctor Manuel Fernández](https://www.wikiwand.com/en/articles/V%C3%ADctor_Manuel_Fern%C3%A1ndez "Víctor Manuel Fernández"), the head of the Vatican doctrine office, told _[Il Messaggero](https://www.wikiwand.com/en/articles/Il_Messaggero "Il Messaggero")_ in July 2025 that he thought the blessing of those in same-sex unions, which had been approved under Pope Francis, would continue under Pope Leo. In May 2025, Cardinal [Jean-Claude Hollerich](https://www.wikiwand.com/en/articles/Jean-Claude_Hollerich "Jean-Claude Hollerich") told _[La Stampa](https://www.wikiwand.com/en/articles/La_Stampa "La Stampa")_ that he believed Leo "might re-interpret" _Fiducia Supplicans,_ but not "abolish" it.[\[235\]](https://www.wikiwand.com/en/articles/Pope_Leo_XIV#cite_note-246)[\[236\]](https://www.wikiwand.com/en/articles/Pope_Leo_XIV#cite_note-247)

In 2012, Prevost criticized popular culture's sympathy for the "homosexual lifestyle" and same-sex families.[\[133\]](https://www.wikiwand.com/en/articles/Pope_Leo_XIV#cite_note-Rich_2025-142) In April 2016, he opposed the inclusion of "[gender ideology](https://www.wikiwand.com/en/articles/Gender_ideology "Gender ideology")" in Peruvian primary school curricula,[\[237\]](https://www.wikiwand.com/en/articles/Pope_Leo_XIV#cite_note-248) stating it promotes "genders that don't exist".[\[133\]](https://www.wikiwand.com/en/articles/Pope_Leo_XIV#cite_note-Rich_2025-142) When asked in 2023 by [Catholic News Service](https://www.wikiwand.com/en/articles/Catholic_News_Service "Catholic News Service") whether his views from 2012 had changed, Prevost said that "many things have changed" and emphasized the church should be more open and welcoming though he cautioned that church doctrine has not changed.[\[238\]](https://www.wikiwand.com/en/articles/Pope_Leo_XIV#cite_note-249)[\[239\]](https://www.wikiwand.com/en/articles/Pope_Leo_XIV#cite_note-250)

In May 2025, Leo XIV said that it was up to governments to build peaceful societies "above all by investing in the family, founded upon the stable union between a man and a woman."[\[240\]](https://www.wikiwand.com/en/articles/Pope_Leo_XIV#cite_note-251) In September 2025, Leo told Reverend [James J. Martin](https://www.wikiwand.com/en/articles/James_J._Martin_/(priest/) "James J. Martin (priest)"), a major advocate for greater LGBTQ+ inclusion in the Church, that he would continue Francis' legacy of welcoming LGBTQ+ people into the Church, with Martin telling [The Associated Press](https://www.wikiwand.com/en/articles/The_Associated_Press "The Associated Press") that their discussion "was very consoling and very encouraging and frankly a lot of fun."[\[241\]](https://www.wikiwand.com/en/articles/Pope_Leo_XIV#cite_note-252)

#### Geopolitics

[![Image 11: Thumb](https://upload.wikimedia.org/wikipedia/commons/thumb/4/43/Lula_Papa_Le%C3%A3o_XIV_13.10.2025_%28cropped%29.jpg/640px-Lula_Papa_Le%C3%A3o_XIV_13.10.2025_%28cropped%29.jpg)](https://www.wikiwand.com/en/articles/Pope_Leo_XIV#/media/File:Lula_Papa_Le%C3%A3o_XIV_13.10.2025_\(cropped\).jpg)

Leo with President of Brazil [Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva](https://www.wikiwand.com/en/articles/Luiz_In%C3%A1cio_Lula_da_Silva "Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva") in October 2025

During his time in Chiclayo, Prevost remained relatively politically neutral on national issues. However, in the midst of the [Peruvian protests](https://www.wikiwand.com/en/articles/Peruvian_protests_/(2022%E2%80%932023/) "Peruvian protests (2022–2023)") in 2023, he stated: "The deaths during the protests cause me great sadness and pain \[...\] I asked to stay in Peru; I even made that request to the Holy Father. It wasn't the time to leave."[\[242\]](https://www.wikiwand.com/en/articles/Pope_Leo_XIV#cite_note-253) He has also expressed support for the plight of Venezuelan refugees in Peru.[\[243\]](https://www.wikiwand.com/en/articles/Pope_Leo_XIV#cite_note-McElwee_2025-254)[\[244\]](https://www.wikiwand.com/en/articles/Pope_Leo_XIV#cite_note-255) With regards to [climate change](https://www.wikiwand.com/en/articles/Climate_change "Climate change"), Prevost has advocated for stronger church action, stating in a November 2024 seminar that "dominion over nature" should not be "tyrannical".[\[147\]](https://www.wikiwand.com/en/articles/Pope_Leo_XIV#cite_note-Burga_2025-157) He called for [Environmental protection](https://www.wikiwand.com/en/articles/Environmental_protection "Environmental protection"), supporting the installation of [solar panels](https://www.wikiwand.com/en/articles/Solar_panels "Solar panels") and [electric vehicles](https://www.wikiwand.com/en/articles/Electric_vehicles "Electric vehicles").[\[245\]](https://www.wikiwand.com/en/articles/Pope_Leo_XIV#cite_note-256)

On geopolitics, Prevost has consistently advocated against armed conflict. He denounced the [Russian invasion of Ukraine](https://www.wikiwand.com/en/articles/Russian_invasion_of_Ukraine "Russian invasion of Ukraine"), describing it as "a true invasion, imperialist in nature, where Russia seeks to conquer territory for reasons of power",[\[246\]](https://www.wikiwand.com/en/articles/Pope_Leo_XIV#cite_note-257) and in one of his first major speeches as pope, Leo called for a ceasefire in the [Gaza war](https://www.wikiwand.com/en/articles/Gaza_war "Gaza war"),[\[247\]](https://www.wikiwand.com/en/articles/Pope_Leo_XIV#cite_note-258)[\[248\]](https://www.wikiwand.com/en/articles/Pope_Leo_XIV#cite_note-259)[\[249\]](https://www.wikiwand.com/en/articles/Pope_Leo_XIV#cite_note-260) later describing Trump's then-proposed [Gaza peace plan](https://www.wikiwand.com/en/articles/Gaza_peace_plan "Gaza peace plan") as "realistic."[\[250\]](https://www.wikiwand.com/en/articles/Pope_Leo_XIV#cite_note-Faiola_&_Craw_October_2025-261) Following the [Israeli strikes on Iran](https://www.wikiwand.com/en/articles/June_2025_Israeli_strikes_on_Iran "June 2025 Israeli strikes on Iran") in June 2025, he urged Iranian and Israeli authorities to act with "reason".[\[251\]](https://www.wikiwand.com/en/articles/Pope_Leo_XIV#cite_note-262) On August 27, Leo said, "I beg for a permanent ceasefire to be reached, the safe entry of humanitarian aid to be facilitated and humanitarian law to be fully respected."[\[252\]](https://www.wikiwand.com/en/articles/Pope_Leo_XIV#cite_note-NBC,_Israel_faces_new_pressure_over_hospital_strikes,_August_27,_2025-263) [_The_ _Washington Post_](https://www.wikiwand.com/en/articles/The_Washington_Post "The Washington Post") reported in September 2025 that Leo said the Vatican "at this time" cannot define the war as a "genocide", but he also noted that more and more people have described it as such.[\[253\]](https://www.wikiwand.com/en/articles/Pope_Leo_XIV#cite_note-264) Leo also issued prayers for those affected by the [clashes in southern Syria](https://www.wikiwand.com/en/articles/Southern_Syria_clashes_/(July_2025%E2%80%93present/) "Southern Syria clashes (July 2025–present)") and the [2025 Cambodia–Thailand clashes](https://www.wikiwand.com/en/articles/2025_Cambodia%E2%80%93Thailand_clashes "2025 Cambodia–Thailand clashes").[\[254\]](https://www.wikiwand.com/en/articles/Pope_Leo_XIV#cite_note-265) Leo lamented the [El Fasher massacre](https://www.wikiwand.com/en/articles/El_Fasher_massacre "El Fasher massacre") in [Sudan](https://www.wikiwand.com/en/articles/Sudan "Sudan") during his Sunday Angelus address on November 2, 2025, calling for a ceasefire and humanitarian aid.[\[255\]](https://www.wikiwand.com/en/articles/Pope_Leo_XIV#cite_note-266) In November 2025, Leo criticized the [United States' military strikes against alleged drug traffickers](https://www.wikiwand.com/en/articles/2025_United_States_military_strikes_on_alleged_drug_traffickers "2025 United States military strikes on alleged drug traffickers") near [Venezuela](https://www.wikiwand.com/en/articles/Venezuela "Venezuela"), warning that they were "increasing tension" and calling for diplomatic dialogue between the two countries.[\[256\]](https://www.wikiwand.com/en/articles/Pope_Leo_XIV#cite_note-AP_11-05-2025-267)

In his [Pentecost](https://www.wikiwand.com/en/articles/Pentecost "Pentecost") homily soon after his election as Pope, Leo criticized the "exclusionary mindset" displayed by various [nationalist](https://www.wikiwand.com/en/articles/Nationalism "Nationalism") movements. The [Holy Spirit](https://www.wikiwand.com/en/articles/Holy_Spirit_in_Christianity "Holy Spirit in Christianity") "breaks down barriers and tears down the walls of indifference and hatred", he said.[\[257\]](https://www.wikiwand.com/en/articles/Pope_Leo_XIV#cite_note-Reuters1-268) To Leo, areas advertised as "security zones" had the effect of "separating us from our neighbors" and spreading "prejudice". He proclaimed that the Church needed to "open the borders between peoples and break down the barriers between class and race."[\[257\]](https://www.wikiwand.com/en/articles/Pope_Leo_XIV#cite_note-Reuters1-268) Leo additionally condemned [femicide](https://www.wikiwand.com/en/articles/Femicide "Femicide") during the homily, calling it both painful and tragic and attributing it to "an unhealthy desire for domination."[\[258\]](https://www.wikiwand.com/en/articles/Pope_Leo_XIV#cite_note-Korea_Herald_2025-269)[\[259\]](https://www.wikiwand.com/en/articles/Pope_Leo_XIV#cite_note-Allen_2025-270)

#### US politics

Throughout his time as a bishop and as a cardinal, Prevost continued to vote in both state and federal elections in the United States, being a [registered voter](https://www.wikiwand.com/en/articles/Voter_registration "Voter registration") in [Will County, Illinois](https://www.wikiwand.com/en/articles/Will_County,_Illinois "Will County, Illinois"). Illinois election law does not require voters to register affiliation with a political party, and Prevost has never officially done so.[\[260\]](https://www.wikiwand.com/en/articles/Pope_Leo_XIV#cite_note-271) The elections Prevost has voted in include the [2008 Democratic presidential primary](https://www.wikiwand.com/en/articles/2008_Illinois_Democratic_presidential_primary "2008 Illinois Democratic presidential primary"), the Democratic primary for the [2010 Illinois gubernatorial election](https://www.wikiwand.com/en/articles/2010_Illinois_gubernatorial_election#Democratic_primary "2010 Illinois gubernatorial election"), the [2012 Republican presidential primary](https://www.wikiwand.com/en/articles/2012_Illinois_Republican_presidential_primary "2012 Illinois Republican presidential primary"), the Republican primary for the [2014 Illinois gubernatorial election](https://www.wikiwand.com/en/articles/2014_Illinois_gubernatorial_election#Republican_primary "2014 Illinois gubernatorial election"), the [2016 Republican presidential primary](https://www.wikiwand.com/en/articles/2016_Illinois_Republican_presidential_primary "2016 Illinois Republican presidential primary"), and the [2024 United States general election](https://www.wikiwand.com/en/articles/2024_Illinois_elections "2024 Illinois elections").[\[261\]](https://www.wikiwand.com/en/articles/Pope_Leo_XIV#cite_note-272)[\[262\]](https://www.wikiwand.com/en/articles/Pope_Leo_XIV#cite_note-273)[\[263\]](https://www.wikiwand.com/en/articles/Pope_Leo_XIV#cite_note-274)

On the social media platform X (formerly [Twitter](https://www.wikiwand.com/en/articles/Twitter "Twitter")), Prevost's former account reposted posts critical of US immigration policies under President [Donald Trump](https://www.wikiwand.com/en/articles/Donald_Trump "Donald Trump") and Vice President [JD Vance](https://www.wikiwand.com/en/articles/JD_Vance "JD Vance").[\[264\]](https://www.wikiwand.com/en/articles/Pope_Leo_XIV#cite_note-275) He has also expressed support for [COVID-19 vaccination](https://www.wikiwand.com/en/articles/COVID-19_vaccination "COVID-19 vaccination") during the [COVID-19 pandemic](https://www.wikiwand.com/en/articles/COVID-19_pandemic "COVID-19 pandemic") and sympathy for [George Floyd](https://www.wikiwand.com/en/articles/George_Floyd "George Floyd") and [protesters](https://www.wikiwand.com/en/articles/George_Floyd_protests "George Floyd protests").[\[22\]](https://www.wikiwand.com/en/articles/Pope_Leo_XIV#cite_note-kim-25) His X account which he used prior to his election as Pope has since been deleted and he is currently using the official @Pontifex handle, inherited from Popes Benedict XVI and Francis.[\[265\]](https://www.wikiwand.com/en/articles/Pope_Leo_XIV#cite_note-276) As Pope, Leo avoided discussing US politics for the first few months of his pontificate, but in September 2025 reiterated past criticisms of the second Trump administration, remarking to a group of journalists that "someone who says 'I am against abortion but I am in agreement with the inhuman treatment of immigrants in the United States,' I don't know if that's pro-life."[\[266\]](https://www.wikiwand.com/en/articles/Pope_Leo_XIV#cite_note-McElwee_Trump_Leo_September_2025-277)[\[250\]](https://www.wikiwand.com/en/articles/Pope_Leo_XIV#cite_note-Faiola_&_Craw_October_2025-261) White House press secretary [Karoline Leavitt](https://www.wikiwand.com/en/articles/Karoline_Leavitt "Karoline Leavitt") denied Leo's claims of maltreatment.[\[267\]](https://www.wikiwand.com/en/articles/Pope_Leo_XIV#cite_note-Sentner_2025-278) That October, Leo urged labor unions in his home city of Chicago to fight for immigrants' rights. In November, he called for a "deep reflection" about American immigration policy and asked that detainees' "spiritual rights" be upheld via access to clergy.[\[256\]](https://www.wikiwand.com/en/articles/Pope_Leo_XIV#cite_note-AP_11-05-2025-267)

In addition to his native English, Leo speaks Spanish, Italian, French, and Portuguese, as well as some German. He can also read Latin.[\[114\]](https://www.wikiwand.com/en/articles/Pope_Leo_XIV#cite_note-NCR_2025-121)[\[268\]](https://www.wikiwand.com/en/articles/Pope_Leo_XIV#cite_note-279)[\[269\]](https://www.wikiwand.com/en/articles/Pope_Leo_XIV#cite_note-280) During his time in Peru, Leo learned a little of one of the [Quechuan languages](https://www.wikiwand.com/en/articles/Quechuan_languages "Quechuan languages").[\[270\]](https://www.wikiwand.com/en/articles/Pope_Leo_XIV#cite_note-281)[\[271\]](https://www.wikiwand.com/en/articles/Pope_Leo_XIV#cite_note-282) He has described himself as "quite the amateur tennis player".[\[272\]](https://www.wikiwand.com/en/articles/Pope_Leo_XIV#cite_note-283) He is the first Pope who writes his own emails and wears a smartwatch, specifically an [Apple Watch](https://www.wikiwand.com/en/articles/Apple_Watch "Apple Watch").[\[273\]](https://www.wikiwand.com/en/articles/Pope_Leo_XIV#cite_note-Lamb-284) He regularly plays _[Wordle](https://www.wikiwand.com/en/articles/Wordle "Wordle")_ and _[Words with Friends](https://www.wikiwand.com/en/articles/Words_with_Friends "Words with Friends")_ with his brothers.[\[274\]](https://www.wikiwand.com/en/articles/Pope_Leo_XIV#cite_note-285)[\[275\]](https://www.wikiwand.com/en/articles/Pope_Leo_XIV#cite_note-286)

Leo is a lifelong fan of the [Chicago White Sox](https://www.wikiwand.com/en/articles/Chicago_White_Sox "Chicago White Sox") of [Major League Baseball](https://www.wikiwand.com/en/articles/Major_League_Baseball "Major League Baseball"),[\[276\]](https://www.wikiwand.com/en/articles/Pope_Leo_XIV#cite_note-287)[\[277\]](https://www.wikiwand.com/en/articles/Pope_Leo_XIV#cite_note-288)[\[278\]](https://www.wikiwand.com/en/articles/Pope_Leo_XIV#cite_note-289) and was in attendance at [US Cellular Field](https://www.wikiwand.com/en/articles/US_Cellular_Field "US Cellular Field") for Game 1 of the [2005 World Series](https://www.wikiwand.com/en/articles/2005_World_Series "2005 World Series").[\[279\]](https://www.wikiwand.com/en/articles/Pope_Leo_XIV#cite_note-290)[\[280\]](https://www.wikiwand.com/en/articles/Pope_Leo_XIV#cite_note-291)[\[281\]](https://www.wikiwand.com/en/articles/Pope_Leo_XIV#cite_note-292) His support for [Chicago sports](https://www.wikiwand.com/en/articles/Sports_in_Chicago "Sports in Chicago") also extends to the [National Football League](https://www.wikiwand.com/en/articles/National_Football_League "National Football League")'s [Chicago Bears](https://www.wikiwand.com/en/articles/Chicago_Bears "Chicago Bears"); United States Vice President [JD Vance](https://www.wikiwand.com/en/articles/JD_Vance "JD Vance") presented him with a custom Bears jersey following his papal inauguration, which Leo remarked was a "good choice".[\[282\]](https://www.wikiwand.com/en/articles/Pope_Leo_XIV#cite_note-293) He has also shown support for [Villanova University athletics](https://www.wikiwand.com/en/articles/Villanova_University_athletics "Villanova University athletics"), especially the [Villanova Wildcats men's basketball](https://www.wikiwand.com/en/articles/Villanova_Wildcats_men's_basketball "Villanova Wildcats men's basketball") team.[\[283\]](https://www.wikiwand.com/en/articles/Pope_Leo_XIV#cite_note-294) In a review of an upcoming biography about him, the _Washington Post_ reported that in a hypothetical [World Cup](https://www.wikiwand.com/en/articles/FIFA_World_Cup "FIFA World Cup") match-up between the [United States](https://www.wikiwand.com/en/articles/United_States_men's_national_soccer_team "United States men's national soccer team") and [Peru](https://www.wikiwand.com/en/articles/Peru_national_football_team "Peru national football team"), Leo would support Peru.[\[284\]](https://www.wikiwand.com/en/articles/Pope_Leo_XIV#cite_note-295)

As a teenager, he enjoyed driving recreationally.[\[40\]](https://www.wikiwand.com/en/articles/Pope_Leo_XIV#cite_note-Tucker_2025-44) Throughout his life, he has frequently preferred [driving long distances](https://www.wikiwand.com/en/articles/Road_trip "Road trip") for journeys where most people would prefer to fly, such as from Philadelphia to Chicago, Brisbane to Sydney, and Chiclayo to Lima.[\[9\]](https://www.wikiwand.com/en/articles/Pope_Leo_XIV#cite_note-Horowitz,_Bosman,_Dias,_Graham,_Romero_&_Taj_2025-12) He also repaired cars himself as a bishop in Chiclayo.[\[285\]](https://www.wikiwand.com/en/articles/Pope_Leo_XIV#cite_note-296)

For two years before becoming pope, Prevost, aged 68–69, would go two to three times a week to a gym for an hour, with a workout plan designed for men aged 50–55, focusing on posture and cardiovascular health. His personal trainer recalled Prevost's stamina and his being "always positive about everything".[\[286\]](https://www.wikiwand.com/en/articles/Pope_Leo_XIV#cite_note-297)

During his time as bishop of Chiclayo, aside from daily [Mass](https://www.wikiwand.com/en/articles/Eucharist "Eucharist") celebrated at 8 p.m. to ensure a clear mind, Prevost had [periods of prayer](https://www.wikiwand.com/en/articles/Mental_prayer "Mental prayer") at the beginning of the day and before dinner. He prayed [lauds](https://www.wikiwand.com/en/articles/Lauds "Lauds") in the morning at the Cathedral and the [rosary](https://www.wikiwand.com/en/articles/Rosary "Rosary") with his priest colleagues around noon.[\[86\]](https://www.wikiwand.com/en/articles/Pope_Leo_XIV#cite_note-Beltr%C3%A1n-91)

Villanova awarded him an honorary [Doctor of Humanities](https://www.wikiwand.com/en/articles/Doctor_of_Humanities "Doctor of Humanities") degree in 2014.[\[49\]](https://www.wikiwand.com/en/articles/Pope_Leo_XIV#cite_note-Mervosh_2025-53) In 2025, _[Time](https://www.wikiwand.com/en/articles/Time_/(magazine/) "Time (magazine)")_ magazine included Leo among [the world's 100 most influential people](https://www.wikiwand.com/en/articles/Time_100 "Time 100") in [Artificial Intelligence](https://www.wikiwand.com/en/articles/Artificial_Intelligence "Artificial Intelligence").[\[287\]](https://www.wikiwand.com/en/articles/Pope_Leo_XIV#cite_note-298) On October 23, 2025, King [Charles III](https://www.wikiwand.com/en/articles/Charles_III "Charles III") appointed Leo an Honorary Knight Grand Cross of the [Order of the Bath](https://www.wikiwand.com/en/articles/Order_of_the_Bath "Order of the Bath") on the occasion of the King's [state visit to the Holy See](https://www.wikiwand.com/en/articles/State_visit_by_Charles_III_to_the_Holy_See "State visit by Charles III to the Holy See").[\[288\]](https://www.wikiwand.com/en/articles/Pope_Leo_XIV#cite_note-299) At the same event Leo accepted the title of _Papal Confrater of St. George's Chapel_ in Windsor Castle.[\[289\]](https://www.wikiwand.com/en/articles/Pope_Leo_XIV#cite_note-300)

3.  While working in Peru and Latin America as bishop (2015–2023), Prevost customarily used the name "Robert Francis Prevost Martínez" in accordance with [Hispanic naming customs](https://www.wikiwand.com/en/articles/Spanish_naming_customs "Spanish naming customs"), as Martínez is his mother's family name.[\[4\]](https://www.wikiwand.com/en/articles/Pope_Leo_XIV#cite_note-6)[\[5\]](https://www.wikiwand.com/en/articles/Pope_Leo_XIV#cite_note-7)[\[6\]](https://www.wikiwand.com/en/articles/Pope_Leo_XIV#cite_note-8)[\[7\]](https://www.wikiwand.com/en/articles/Pope_Leo_XIV#cite_note-9)
    
4.  St. Mary's Church in Dolton was closed in 2011.[\[38\]](https://www.wikiwand.com/en/articles/Pope_Leo_XIV#cite_note-41)
    
5.  That Ray was allowed to live at the friary was first reported by the _[Chicago Sun-Times](https://www.wikiwand.com/en/articles/Chicago_Sun-Times "Chicago Sun-Times")_ in 2021, based on documents the church made public in 2014.[\[75\]](https://www.wikiwand.com/en/articles/Pope_Leo_XIV#cite_note-Herguth_2021-79)
    
6.  His role in Callao ended upon the installation of a new bishop there on May 26, 2021.
    
7.  This interview was conducted while Prevost was bishop but was published after he was elected pope.[\[105\]](https://www.wikiwand.com/en/articles/Pope_Leo_XIV#cite_note-AFP_2025-111)
    

9.  Prevost's plan to take possession of Albano on May 12 were cancelled when the conclave to elect Francis' successor was scheduled.[\[119\]](https://www.wikiwand.com/en/articles/Pope_Leo_XIV#cite_note-127)
    
10.  He is the 265th person to become Pope as [Pope Benedict IX](https://www.wikiwand.com/en/articles/Pope_Benedict_IX "Pope Benedict IX") was elected three times.
    
11.  The positions of cardinals are difficult to pinpoint in political terms and different labels, more specific to the Church's context like _sinodali_ (supporters of synodality), _lealisti_ (loyalists, the supporters of the reigning pope), and _tradizionalisti_ (traditionalists), are applied. Nonetheless, Prevost was generally seen as a "reformer of the Bergoglian area", not far from other more progressive names like [Pietro Parolin](https://www.wikiwand.com/en/articles/Pietro_Parolin "Pietro Parolin") and [Luis Antonio Tagle](https://www.wikiwand.com/en/articles/Luis_Antonio_Tagle "Luis Antonio Tagle"), and more moderate than others like [Robert Walter McElroy](https://www.wikiwand.com/en/articles/Robert_Walter_McElroy "Robert Walter McElroy") and [Matteo Maria Zuppi](https://www.wikiwand.com/en/articles/Matteo_Maria_Zuppi "Matteo Maria Zuppi").[\[226\]](https://www.wikiwand.com/en/articles/Pope_Leo_XIV#cite_note-236)

Pope Leo XIV at Inauguration Mass: ‘Let us walk towards God and love one another’
=================================================================================

Sunday, May 18th, 2025 @ 11:03 am

[![Image 4: Facebook](https://www.cbcew.org.uk/wp-content/themes/bishconfBase/images/social-fb-colour.svg)](https://www.facebook.com/sharer/sharer.php?u=http://www.cbcew.org.uk/pope-leo-xiv-at-inauguration-mass-let-us-walk-towards-god-and-love-one-another/) [![Image 5: Twitter](https://www.cbcew.org.uk/wp-content/themes/bishconfBase/images/social-twitter-colour.svg)](http://twitter.com/share?url=http://www.cbcew.org.uk/pope-leo-xiv-at-inauguration-mass-let-us-walk-towards-god-and-love-one-another/) [![Image 6: WhatsApp](https://www.cbcew.org.uk/wp-content/themes/bishconfBase/images/social-whatsApp-colour.svg)](whatsapp://send?text=http://www.cbcew.org.uk/pope-leo-xiv-at-inauguration-mass-let-us-walk-towards-god-and-love-one-another/) [![Image 7: Email](https://www.cbcew.org.uk/wp-content/themes/bishconfBase/images/social-email-colour.svg)](mailto:?subject=Iwantedyoutoseethissite&body=Havealookatthissitehttp://www.cbcew.org.uk/pope-leo-xiv-at-inauguration-mass-let-us-walk-towards-god-and-love-one-another/)

![Image 8](https://cbcew.b-cdn.net/wp-content/uploads/sites/3/2025/05/Pope-leo-xiv-waves-audience-1140-641.jpg)

[Vatican](https://www.cbcew.org.uk/category/vatican/) » [Pope](https://www.cbcew.org.uk/category/vatican/pope/) » [Pope Leo XIV](https://www.cbcew.org.uk/category/vatican/pope/pope-leo-xiv/) » » Pope Leo XIV at Inauguration Mass: ...

Greeting over 100,000 pilgrims, leaders from around the world, and representatives of Christian denominations, Pope Leo XIV marked the joyous start to his Petrine Ministry, officially inaugurating it with Mass in Saint Peter’s Square on Sunday, 18 May.

Religious delegations included Jewish, Muslim, Hindu, Buddhist, Sikh, Zoroastrian and Jainists, among the many present for the celebration.

#### Heart full of gratitude

Expressing his heartfelt gratitude for the prayerful and joyful support offered to him as he begins his pastoral ministry as Pope, Leo XIV recalled the intense emotions experienced over these past few weeks.

“Following the death of Pope Francis, we felt like sheep without a shepherd,” he recalled, “yet having received his final blessing on Easter Sunday, and with eyes of faith, hope, and joy, we remembered how the Lord never abandons His people.”

The Pope also thanked everyone for accompanying in prayer the College of Cardinals meeting in conclave to elect the Successor of Peter as they looked at how to continue the mission of preaching the Gospel with a shepherd able to address today’s challenges.

He said they felt “the working of the Holy Spirit, who was able to bring us into harmony, like musical instruments, so that our heartstrings could vibrate in a single melody.”

#### United in love and unity

“I was chosen, without any merit of my own, and now, with fear and trembling,” said Pope Leo, “_I come to you as a brother_, who desires to be the servant of your faith and your joy, walking with you on the path of God’s love, for he wants us all to be united in one family.”

Pope Leo XIV recalled how love and unity are the two aspects of the mission entrusted to Peter by Jesus.

In the Gospel on this Sunday, Jesus entrusts the disciples to continue the mission, to be “fishers of men” and bring the “hope of the Gospel” to all people “so that all may experience God’s embrace.”

Peter’s experience of God’s “infinite and unconditional love of God,” despite his own weakness and denial, enabled him to take up this mission, the Pope explained.

#### Self-sacrificing love

Pope Leo recalled how Peter is entrusted then with “loving more” and “giving his life for the flock,” a “self-sacrificing love.”

“The ministry of Peter is distinguished precisely by this self-sacrificing love, because the Church of Rome presides in charity and its true authority is the charity of Christ. It is never a question of capturing others by force, by religious propaganda or by means of power. Instead, it is always and only a question of loving as Jesus did.”

#### Church, sign of unity and communion

The Holy Father expressed his hope that the entire Church be united by a “great desire be for a united Church, a sign of unity and communion, which becomes a leaven for a reconciled world.”

In the face of a world marked by so much discord and wounds caused by hatred, violence, prejudice, fear, and economic reality “that exploits the Earth’s resources and marginalises the poorest,” the Pope said, “we want to be a small leaven of unity, communion, and fraternity within the world.”

“We want to say to the world, with humility and joy: Look to Christ! Come closer to him! Welcome his word that enlightens and consoles! Listen to his offer of love and become his one family: in the one Christ, we are one,” he urged. “This is the path to follow together, among ourselves but also with our sister Christian churches, with those who follow other religious paths, with those who are searching for God, with all women and men of good will, in order to build a new world where peace reigns!”

The Pope upheld the missionary spirit, adding that such an approach will keep the Church from closing itself off in small groups or taking on a feeling of superiority to the world.

“We are called to offer God’s love to everyone, in order to achieve that unity which does not cancel out differences but values the personal history of each person and the social and religious culture of every people,” he said.

“Brothers and sisters, this is the hour for love! The heart of the Gospel is the love of God that makes us brothers and sisters.”

In conclusion, Pope Leo XIV invited all Christians to be enlightened by the Holy Spirit, so that we might build a Church “founded on God’s love, a sign of unity, a missionary Church that opens its arms to the world, proclaims the word, allows itself to be made ‘restless’ by history, and becomes a leaven of harmony for humanity.”

“Together, as one people, as brothers and sisters, let us walk towards God and love one another.”

On the Election of His Holiness Pope Leo XIV
============================================

Press Statement

[Marco Rubio, Secretary of State](https://www.state.gov/biographies/marco-rubio/)

May 8, 2025

I extend my heartfelt congratulations to His Holiness Pope Leo XIV on his election as the 267th successor to Saint Peter. This is a moment of profound significance for the Catholic Church, offering renewed hope and continuity amid the 2025 Jubilee Year to over a billion faithful worldwide. The papacy carries a sacred and solemn responsibility. Jeanette and I are united in prayer for His Holiness, may the Holy Spirit impart wisdom, strength, and grace as he shepherds the Church. The United States looks forward to deepening our enduring relationship with the Holy See with the first American pontiff.

The Vatican has warned that AI-generated deepfake videos falsely depicting Pope Leo XIV are circulating online. The video involves an AI system generating synthetic audiovisual content (deepfake) that falsely attributes statements to a public figure, leading to misinformation and potential harm to communities through deception and propaganda. Although the video is fictional and labeled as such, the widespread misleading impact and the nature of the AI-generated content meet the criteria for an AI Incident due to harm to communities via misinformation. Therefore, this event qualifies as an AI Incident.[AI generated]
